mainObjective: Prevent false Inno Prepare-Upgrade code43 from asynchronous exit of exact already-owned application process while keeping active provider and foreign process safety guards intact.
previousAccepted: GitHub main SHA 28f3572e550f4e4a7e9baaa9582dddbc25df2795; V457 physical R54 first setup exit7/helper43 and R53 browser CFON restored; old R54 draft SHA ed9b89c4... remains unpublished.

rootCause.observed: Owner physical Inno PrepareToInstall abort exit7, helper returned43 when installed UI/pwsh process persisted after only 400ms. Post-abort inspection showed zero owned processes.
rootCause.hypothesis: PowerShell Stop-Process asynchronously terminates owned processes and the 400ms single check was shorter than actual shutdown; process ownership/race exact cause not observed via process trace.
rootCause.externalMethod: Microsoft PowerShell Stop-Process docs explicitly say process termination is asynchronous and recommend Wait-Process; official Wait-Process supports numeric timeout, and Inno event docs say PrepareToInstall may abort before file updates.
